notes.title: 'I Dated A Robot!' new route update is LIVE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34790953/a8542385b69bd47cc515f6609cccb66b739deebb.png[/img]
It's been a wild month, with Trading Cards, Backgrounds and Emoticons all enabled and now, thanks to the herculean efforts of our amazing team, the bonus route 'I Dated A Robot!' has been delivered and is now available for you to download and play for free! ːlugamecontrollerː

As our way of saying thank you for all your wonderful love, support and feedback, this massive update to include the 'I Dated A Robot!' route is completely free and features all of the following: ːlugamegamechildː
[list]
[*] 25,000 words of additional story in a new K-T route!
[*] 2 New Achievements
[*] 5 New Outfits
[*] 2 New Songs
[*] 3 New CGs
[*] 5 New Locations
[*] 3 New WEBM animations
[*] Bonus Content Access Panel
[*] CG Gallery Feature
[*] Visual Companion Feature
[*] All for free
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34790953/4e119cc775e04ea69742c79f1429cc992c31c9a9.png[/img]

To play the new route, simply access the new 'Bonus Content' panel, select 'I Dated A Robot!' from the menu and click 'Play Now'. Since this is a massive overhaul build it's possible you may experience bugs, please direct any bug reports to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/812840/discussions/]Steam Discussions forums[/url]! Thank you! ːlugamejoystickː

And finally, please take a moment to congratulate the team on their heroic efforts!
[list]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/jelpiparade]owl.[/url] for her incredible writing talent, without which LuGame would not be possible.
[*][url=https://twitter.com/SpewingMews]SpewingMews [/url]for her gorgeous artwork that breaths life into your adorable waifus!
[*][url=https://twitter.com/WhiteCharism]WhiteCharisma[/url] who went above and beyond to provide our top-notch 3D scenes.
[*][url=https://twitter.com/dssansVN]ds-sans[/url] who completely overhauled our GUI.
[*][url=https://twitter.com/tyberalyx]Alyx[/url] who delivered his two bonus songs before his computer gave in.
[*][url=https://twitter.com/renpytom]RenpyTom[/url] for making this all possible with Ren'Py.
[*][url=https://twitter.com/MoozuaMary]Moozua[/url] who provides all the illustrations drawn by K-T.
[*]And YOU, for making all this possible!
[/list]

Have fun, enjoy and play nice! ːlugamebotː

notes.title: Free Content Update In November!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34790953/5a9735fe6288f284355a90f1257544a1427d1d78.png[/img]Every review has helped us improve the LuGame experience and thanks to your feedback we have a huge announcement - A free content update packed full of new features!

Our team and [b]ds-sans[/b] (developer of the highly anticipated Visual Novel [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/734900/Chemically_Bonded/]Chemically Bonded[/url]) to develop new tools and features for Ren'Py and combine it with an enormous package for update v1.07 that will feature the following:[list]
[*] 20,000 words of additional story
[*] 5 New Outfits
[*] 2 New Songs
[*] 3 New CGs
[*] 5 New Locations
[*] Bonus Content Access Panel
[*] CG Gallery Feature
[*] All for [b]free[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34790953/9ce4a4f35385c0cbe6655b20f749bdf0a759cd4b.png[/img]
It's such a big update, that v1.07 will receive [b]its own trailer[/b], viewable on the Steam Store Page.
So make sure you've ticked [b]"Following"[/b] on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/812840/LuGame_Lunchtime_Games_Club]LuGame Steam store page[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/LuGameVN]follow LuGame on Twitter[/url] to be informed when the final release date for v1.07 is revealed! 

Thanks again for all your love and support!
We couldn't do it without you! ːlugamebotː

H. Hochkins
Director, Urban Meadows Publishing

notes.title: Missing Mac Executable 1.06.3 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34790953/82eb3c12792cccdc90bb80d84a3becbd152af07d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34790953/fefbf8397fc0c688ab2c9bf98b37eeac76ea7d33.png[/img][/url]
Fixed a Steampipe bug, Mac users can now access their game.
If you are a Mac user and you're experiencing a 'missing executable file' error, then your files need to be updated! Simply perform the following:
[list]
[*] Exit Steam completely
[*] Make sure you have an internet connection
[*] Open Steam and sign in
[*] Click 'Play LuGame' from your Steam library
[*] The game should automatically update
[*] Enjoy your waifus
[/list]
If you have any issues please leave a comment or open a discussion thread. Thank you for your continued support!
